quests.name: The Dark East Road
quests.text: Hollow Wolves have been seen on the east road since the Brightfield lanterns failed. Thin their numbers before they reach the walls.
quests.done: The road is quieter already. Good work, both of you.

quests.name: Moonpetal for the Wounded
quests.text: Moonpetal blooms where lantern light once fell. It glows faintly at night. Bring me five and I can brew draughts for the watch, and for you.
quests.done: Lovely. These will save lives. Take some draughts for the road.

quests.name: Thorns in the Field
quests.text: Bramble Sprites are spitting thorns at my ore carts in southern Brightfield. Clear five of them and I will make it worth your while.
quests.done: Ha! My carts thank you. Here, something from my forge.

quests.name: The Beast at the Shrine
quests.text: Something huge nests at the Brightfield shrine, where our first beacon stands cold. Slay it, then relight the beacon. Handan, your pendant should wake the flame.
quests.done: I saw the light from here. The road to Murkfen is open. Scout Brannoc waits at the fen camp.

quests.name: The Lost Patrol
quests.text: Three of my scouts went into the fog and never came back. Their lantern tokens would tell me where they fell. Find them.
quests.done: All three... At least now their families will know. Thank you.

quests.name: Lights in the Fog
quests.text: The wisps lure travelers into the deep water. Put out six of them so my people can move again.
quests.done: The fog feels thinner already.

quests.name: Witch of the Fen
quests.text: Mirethal sits on the drowned isle in the north-east, feeding the fen to the Hollow. Her death relights the second beacon, and opens the causeway to the Hollow Keep.
quests.done: Two beacons burning. Only the First Lantern remains, inside the Hollow Keep. Someone... something waits for you there.

quests.name: Breaching the Keep
quests.text: I am what is left of the First Lantern's keeper. The Hollow Knights guard every hall. Break four of them so the shards can be reached.
quests.done: Their armor was empty all along. Only hate filled it.

quests.name: Shards of the First Lantern
quests.text: When the King fell to the Hollow, the First Lantern shattered. Three shards remain in the north, south and east halls. With them, the throne gate will open to your pendant.
quests.done: Your pendant sings with them. The throne gate is open now.

quests.name: The Hollow King
quests.text: He was the lantern's guardian once. Now he is its hunger. End him, and relight the First Lantern on the throne dais.
quests.done: end

quests.name: The North Road
quests.text: Frost on the north road, in autumn. The wells froze overnight. Liora says the King was only a vessel: the shadow in his crown fled north to Frostspire, where the First Lantern was forged. Go to the pass and find Warden Kael.
quests.done: Maren sent you? Then the lowlands are finally listening. Welcome to Frostspire. Stay near the fire when you can, and keep your blades dry.

quests.name: Teeth of the Pass
quests.text: The wolves up here were grey once. Now they run white and hungry, and they hunt anything warm. Thin the packs on the lower slopes.
quests.done: Good. The supply sledges can move again.

quests.name: Embers in the Ice
quests.text: When the forge went cold, its embers scattered and froze. You will see them glowing under the snow. Bring me five and I can keep this camp alive.
quests.done: Feel that? Warm. First warm thing up here in a week.

quests.name: The Frozen Choir
quests.text: Hollow Frostcallers chant on the ridge, and Rime Wraiths follow the song. Every verse makes the mountain colder. Silence six of them.
quests.done: Quiet at last. I had forgotten what the wind sounds like.

quests.name: Walls of Ice
quests.text: Two Rime Colossi stand guard where the forge road climbs. The ice gate behind them answers only to the old forge-flame, and your pendant carries some of it. Break the guardians.
quests.done: The gate is melting. The forge road is yours.

quests.name: The Cold Crown
quests.text: The shadow from the crown found a body worth having: Vyrmhal, the old wyrm that slept under the forge. Kill it, and relight the Forge of the First Flame. Then Velmara keeps its light for good.
quests.done: end
labels: The Forge of the First Flame relit

quests.name: Smoke on the West Road
quests.text: The forge burns and the north is safe, but smoke rises from the Emberwood beyond the west gate. The leaves are burning without fire. The shadow that wore the Cold Crown has gone west. Find Elder Brannoc at the forest edge.
quests.done: Lanternhold sends its two brightest, I see. Good. The wood needs both of you.

quests.name: Hounds of Cinder
quests.text: The wolves of this wood used to sleep under the oaks. Now their fur smoulders and they hunt anything green. Put down eight of them before they burn the eastern groves.
quests.done: The eastern groves can breathe again. Thank you.

quests.name: Heartwood Seeds
quests.text: The great trees drop sap-gems when they are dying, the way a hearth drops its last embers. Gather six before the Hollow takes them. With them I can replant what we lose.
quests.done: Warm still. These will grow. Everything grows back, if someone cares enough.

quests.name: The Ashen Choir
quests.text: Ash Sprites and Ember-Hollowed Knights gather in the clearings and sing the fire deeper into the roots. Silence eight of them.
quests.done: Listen. Birds. I had forgotten the wood had birds.

quests.name: Brutes at the Heartgrove
quests.text: Two Cinder Brutes guard the old gate of the Heartgrove. The gate is grown from living wood and will open for me only when they fall.
quests.done: The gate remembers me. It is opening. Go, and be gentle with him if you can.

quests.name: The Burning Heart
quests.text: Morrowthorn guarded the Heartgrove Lantern for a thousand years. The shadow found him lonely and filled him with fire. Free him, relight the Heartgrove Lantern, and come back to me.
quests.done: I felt him go. He was smiling, I think. The shadow ran west again, to the drowned vale. Captain Ysolde holds the last ship there.

quests.name: Down to the Water
quests.text: Past the western roots the land falls into Glasswater Vale, where a whole city sleeps under the sea. Captain Ysolde keeps the last lantern ship moored on the broken bridge. Find her.
quests.done: Brannoc's wood smoke came over the hills this morning, and then it stopped. That was you? Welcome aboard. What is left of it.

quests.name: Bells Under the Water
quests.text: The Drowned Sentinels were the harbour watch. They still walk their rounds, only now they drag people under. Lay eight of them to rest.
quests.done: The bells went quiet. First time in a year.

quests.name: Tide Pearls
quests.text: The old harbour lamps burned on tide pearls. There are still some along the shore, if the crabs have not swallowed them. Six would light my ship for a month.
quests.done: Look at that glow. My ship has not been this bright since the fleet sailed.

quests.name: The Calling Tide
quests.text: Tidecallers sing on the flooded towers and the Glassback Crabs come running. Every song raises the water an inch. Silence eight of them.
quests.done: The water dropped a hand's width. You can see the old street signs now.

quests.name: Wardens of the Cathedral
quests.text: Two Reef Colossi guard the Drowned Cathedral where the Tidelight sits. The sea gate will not move while they stand.
quests.done: The sea gate is rising. Whatever waits in there is waiting for you.

quests.name: The Drowned Wyrm
quests.text: Thalassar was Vyrmhal's sister. Where he took the cold, she took the sea. The shadow is coiled around her heart. End her, relight the Tidelight and come back to the ship.
quests.done: The tide is going out. All of it. There is one place left where the dark can hide: north, past the vale, where the stars used to be. The Starwatch keeps a seer there. Maelis.

quests.name: Where the Stars Went
quests.text: North of the vale the road climbs into the Starless Crown, the old observatory of the Starwatch. Seer Maelis is the last of them. She has been waiting for someone carrying the First Lantern.
quests.done: There you are. I saw your light coming up the road for three nights. You are later than the stars said, but not by much.

quests.name: Wraiths of the Watch
quests.text: My brothers and sisters of the Starwatch drift through the halls as Starless Wraiths. They drink warmth from anything living. Give eight of them peace.
quests.done: I knew some of their names. Thank you for being quick.

quests.name: Fallen Starlight
quests.text: When the stars went out, pieces of them fell here as star-shards. Each still holds a little light. Bring me six and I can show you the Sovereign's weakness.
quests.done: There. Look in the shards. The Sovereign fears one thing: two lights burning as one. You already know how to do that.

quests.name: The Fallen Host
quests.text: Starfallen Knights and Umbral Archers hold the terraces below the throne. Break their line: eight of them.
quests.done: The terraces are open. One gate left.

quests.name: The Throne Gate
quests.text: Two Void Colossi stand before the throne gate. They were carved to hold the sky up. Now they hold the dark in.
quests.done: The gate is open. Whatever you two have, take all of it with you.

quests.name: The Last Lantern
quests.text: Nyxara, the Hollow Sovereign, waits on the throne of the Starwatch. Every lantern you relit pushed the dark here, into one place. End it, and light the First Lantern under the open sky.
quests.done: end

quests.name: The Hollow Sun
quests.text: The stars came back, Orhun, but when the dark broke something else woke: a Hollow Sun over the southern desert. It burns beacons from the sky down. Go south through Brightfield and find Wayfinder Talia at the edge of the Sunscar Dunes.
quests.done: Liora sent you? Then the sky really is falling. Welcome to the Sunscar. Mind the sand, it moves.

quests.name: Stalkers in the Sand
quests.text: Sandstalkers hunt the dune roads at night and drag whole caravans under. Break eight of them so my people can travel again.
quests.done: The caravan bells are ringing again. That is the sound of people coming home.

quests.name: Pieces of the Sun
quests.text: When the Hollow Sun rose, it shed burning sun-shards across the dunes. Gather six before they set the oasis alight.
quests.done: Careful, they are still warm. With these I can light the way for the caravans.

quests.name: The Sunpriest Choir
quests.text: Dune Wraiths and Hollow Sunpriests sing to the Hollow Sun at the old temples. Silence eight of them.
quests.done: The sky looks a little less red tonight. Thank you.
labels: Foes of the Sunscar Dunes defeated

quests.name: Colossi at the Temple
quests.text: Two Sand Colossi guard the gate to the Sunwell temple. Topple them and the gate will open for anyone carrying the First Lantern.
quests.done: The temple gate is grinding open. The Sand Queen waits inside.

quests.name: The Sand Queen
quests.text: Sekhmar, the Sand Queen, swallowed the Sunwell's flame and grew fat on it. End her, relight the Sunwell, and come back to me.
quests.done: The Sunwell burns clean again. The Hollow Sun's light fell east, into the Thornveil. Druid Oren keeps the jungle road; tell him I sent you.

quests.name: Into the Thornveil
quests.text: East of the dunes, the Hollow Sun's light fell into the Thornveil and the jungle began to grow teeth. Find Druid Oren where the jungle road begins.
quests.done: Talia still sends me strays, I see. Good strays, this time. Welcome to the Thornveil.

quests.name: Teeth in the Green
quests.text: The Vinehounds were jungle dogs once. Now they are more thorn than fur. Thin the packs: eight of them.
quests.done: Quieter. The birds are coming back to the low branches.

quests.name: Dew Lotuses
quests.text: Dew lotuses only open under clean moonlight. Pick six and I can brew a draught that heals what the thorns poison.
quests.done: Lovely. Hold one up to the light. That is what this jungle is supposed to look like.

quests.name: The Overgrown Watch
quests.text: Bloom Sprites and Moss-Grown Knights hold the old watchtowers. Break eight of them.
quests.done: The towers are ours again. I can see the canopy from up there.

quests.name: Brutes at the Root Gate
quests.text: Two Thorn Brutes guard the Root Gate. The gate is alive; it will open for you once its wardens fall.
quests.done: The Root Gate is opening. Be gentle with her if you can. Be quick if you cannot.

quests.name: The Rootmother
quests.text: Verdigris, the Rootmother, wants to grow a wall of thorns over every lantern in Velmara. End her, relight the Verdant Lantern, and return to me.
quests.done: The jungle is breathing again. But the roots told me where the Hollow went: down, into the Cindermaw. Forgemaster Garrick is still there.

quests.name: Down into the Fire
quests.text: The roots led the Hollow down into the Cindermaw, the volcano where the lantern-smiths worked. Forgemaster Garrick never left his forge. Find him.
quests.done: Two of you, and a fox. The roots really are desperate. Come in, get warm. Well, warmer.

quests.name: Magma Hounds
quests.text: Magma Hounds circle my forge every night. Put eight of them down before they chew through the bellows.
quests.done: Good. I can hear myself hammer again.

quests.name: Ember-glass
quests.text: Ember-glass forms where lava meets the cold. Bring me six pieces; I will need them for what comes next.
quests.done: Perfect. Sharp, bright and hot. My favourite kind of rock.

quests.name: The Ash Choir
quests.text: Ashcallers and Cinder Knights guard the lava paths and sing the mountain angry. Silence eight of them.
quests.done: The mountain is grumbling less. That is as calm as it gets here.
labels: Foes of the Cindermaw Caldera defeated

quests.name: Obsidian Wardens
quests.text: Two Obsidian Colossi guard the gate to the Heartforge. Break them and the gate will melt.
quests.done: The gate is down. Ignivar is inside, sitting on my forge like a chicken on an egg.

quests.name: The Ash Wyrm
quests.text: Ignivar is the youngest of Vyrmhal's brood, and he is forging a crown of shadow in my Heartforge. End him, relight the Heartforge, and come back.
quests.done: The Heartforge sings again. But the crown is gone: it was carried up, into the sky, to the Skyreach Spires. Aeromancer Selene watches the winds there.

quests.name: Up into the Sky
quests.text: The shadow crown was carried up the old sky-stairs to the Skyreach Spires, islands that float above the storm. Aeromancer Selene keeps watch there.
quests.done: Visitors! Real ones, with feet! Welcome to the Spires. Do not walk off the edges.

quests.name: Sentinels of the Spires
quests.text: The Skyreach Sentinels guarded these islands for the Starwatch. The Hollow turned them. Lay eight of them to rest.
quests.done: Thank you. They were good guards, once. They deserved better.

quests.name: Storm Feathers
quests.text: The great storm-birds shed feathers that still crackle with lightning. Catch six for me before the wind carries them off.
quests.done: Wonderful. With these I can calm the winds around the Herald's island.

quests.name: Gale and Spark
quests.text: Gale Wisps and Storm Sprites ride the winds and feed the Herald's storm. Silence eight of them.
quests.done: The winds are softer. I can hear birds again, real ones.
labels: Foes of the Skyreach Spires defeated

quests.name: Storm Colossi
quests.text: Two Storm Colossi hold the bridge to the Herald's island. Break them and the wind-gate will open.
quests.done: The wind-gate is open. Zephyrion waits with the crown. Hold on to each other.

quests.name: The Storm Herald
quests.text: Zephyrion means to carry the shadow crown to the Dawnless Gate at the edge of the world. Stop him, relight the Stormlantern, and come back to me.
quests.done: The storm is breaking. And there, past the clouds: the Dawnless Gate. Liora is waiting for you on the other side.

quests.name: The Edge of the World
quests.text: Past the storm lies the Dawnless Gate, where night itself began. Liora went ahead of you. Go to her.
quests.done: You came. Of course you came. This is where every Hollow was born, and where it ends.

quests.name: Hounds of the First Night
quests.text: Umbral Hounds run the black fields before the Gate. Clear eight of them so we can reach the stair.
quests.done: The stair is clear. I can almost feel the morning on the other side.

quests.name: Shards of Dawn
quests.text: Every sunrise that never came left a shard of itself here. Find six dawn-shards; together with the lanterns you lit, they will be enough.
quests.done: Look at them. Three hundred years of mornings, waiting for you.

quests.name: The Last Host
quests.text: Hollow Heralds and Dawnless Titans stand on the stair. Break eight of them.
quests.done: The host is broken. Only the echoes remain.
labels: Foes of the Dawnless Gate defeated

quests.name: Echoes of the King
quests.text: Two echoes of the Hollow King guard the Gate, shadows of a shadow. Free them, and the Gate will open.
quests.done: The Gate is open. Umbrath waits. Whatever happens, hold each other's hands.
labels: Echoes of the Hollow Kings broken

quests.name: The First Shadow
quests.text: Umbrath, the First Shadow, is the night that swallowed Velmara. Break him, and raise the Dawn Lantern at the top of the stair.
quests.done: end

intro: The lanterns on the east road went dark again last night. That makes nine.
Then we light them again. That is the whole plan, right?
You stand in front and hit things. I keep you standing. Lumen judges everyone.
Fair division of labor. Let's go see Elder Maren before she sends someone to drag us.
Brightfield: Smells like rain and wolves out here.
Lumen doesn't like it either. Her tail is all puffed up.
Murkfen: My pendant is warm. Something in this fen remembers the First Lantern.
Mud up to my knees and a haunted swamp. You take me to the nicest places.
You said you wanted to travel more.
Hollow Keep: ...we walk out together. Say it properly.
gnarl: That is not a boar. That is a hill with tusks.
Then be a taller hill. I'll handle the healing.
witch: Two little candles, wading into my fen. I will drink your light slowly.
Orhun, keep her eyes on you. I'll deal with the puddles.
king: The lantern-bearer returns. Give me the shard, child, and I will make the dark painless.
She said no. I'm saying it louder.
When the pendant wakes, I'll need everything you have left. Stay close.
Frostspire Pass: My breath is freezing. And the pendant... it's cold, Orhun. It's never been cold.
Then we find the forge and warm it up again. Stay close to me.
Closer than that and you'll have to carry me.
ch2: Orhun. The pendant is cold again. The light didn't stay.
Then it isn't over. Let's hear what Elder Maren knows.
wyrm: Little flames. The crown told me of you. It said you would be... smaller.
Funny. The King said something like that too.
Watch the breath! Get out of the blue when it glows!
b4: The forge is singing. I can hear it in the pendant.
Every lantern in Velmara is going to feel that.
b1: It's warm. The flame knows the pendant.
One down. Look at that light.
b2: Two beacons. I can see Lanternhold's glow from here.
The Keep is next. I can feel it pulling.
levelup: I learned something new. Remind me to show you.
Was that a level? That was a level.
Lumen's getting cocky. I blame you.
lowhp: Orhun! Back up, I've got you!
ch3: Do you smell that? Smoke, from the west road.
The Emberwood. Maren says nobody goes there any more.
Then somebody should. Let us talk to her.
Emberwood: The leaves are burning, but nothing is on fire.
It is the Hollow. It wears the forest like a cloak.
Stay close. I do not like the way those trees are looking at us.
morrow: Little lanterns... my roots remember light. They remember it hurting.
You were a guardian once, like the King. Let us end this gently.
Gently. Right. Watch the ember rain!
b5: The Heartgrove Lantern. It smells like spring.
Brannoc will want to hear it from us.
Glasswater Vale: A whole city under the water. Look at the spires.
Watch your step. I am not fishing you out of a lake.
tide: The deep keeps everything it takes. It will keep you too.
Get off the surge line when it lights up!
b6: The Tidelight. One dark lantern left in the whole world.
sovereign: I am the dark between every lantern you lit. Every flame you kindled only made my shadow longer.
Then we will burn until there is no shadow left.
sovereign3: Orhun, the pendant... it is answering! It wants both of us!
Then take my hand. Lanternburst, together!
Sunscar Dunes: It is so hot, even at night.
Look at the sky. That sun is not ours.
scorpqueen: Tiny lights in my desert. I will bury you with the caravans.
Stay out of the burning circles!
b8: The Sunwell. Feel that? Real warmth.
One sun down. Talia will want to hear it.
Thornveil: Everything here is green. Even the dark is green.
And everything here wants to eat us.
rootmother: Little sparks... I will grow over you like I grew over the old road.
Watch the roots under your feet!
Dodge out of the snares. I mean it.
b9: The Verdant Lantern. It glows green, like the pendant.
Cindermaw Caldera: Mind the lava. Do not touch the lava. I am serious.
I was not going to touch the lava, Orhun.
ignivar: My brother froze. My sister drowned. I will burn.
He breathes fire in lines! Stay off them!
Then let us end the family business.
b10: The Heartforge. It is singing the same song as the First Flame.
Garrick will cry. Do not tell him I said that.
Skyreach Spires: Orhun, we are above the clouds. Actually above them.
Do not look down. Do not look down.
zephyrion: Every storm that ever broke over Velmara was me. You are two candles in a gale.
b11: The Stormlantern. The wind is singing.
The Dawnless Gate: Everything is red. Like the sky is bleeding.
umbrath: I was here before the first lantern. I will be here after the last.
umbrath3: Orhun! Every lantern we ever lit is answering! I can feel all of them!
Then we light the last one together. Hold on to me!
ch6: Orhun... the sky to the south. Is that a sunrise?
No. That light is wrong. Too red.
Liora will know. Let us find her.

maren: Lanternhold has stood for three hundred winters. It will stand for one more.
Keep your pendant close, Handan. It remembers more than any of us.
sela: A draught a day keeps the Hollow away. Mostly.
If you see moonpetal, pick it gently. It bruises.
dorrak: Steel or potions, I have both. Coin first.
Bring me what you find out there. I buy anything that is not cursed. Mostly.
taner: Stay on the dry paths. The water here has teeth.
My scouts were good people. Every one of them.
ayla: I kept the light for two hundred years. I can keep it a little longer.
The pendant chose her, you know. It does not choose lightly.
kael: Keep moving up here. Standing still is how the cold gets you.
Twenty years on this pass. Never seen the forge-smoke stop. Until now.
If you hear singing on the ridge, do not follow it.
brannoc: The trees here are older than Lanternhold. They remember the first flame. Some of them remember it too well.
Burning without fire. That is the Hollow's way. It takes what a thing loves and makes it hunger.
Walk softly near the Heartgrove. Morrowthorn was my friend, once.
ysolde: Glasswater was a harbour city. The sea came in one night and never left.
My ship is the only one that still flies the lantern. Fleet of one. Very exclusive.
If you hear bells under the water, run. The drowned ring them when they are hungry.
maelis: The Starwatch counted every star over Velmara for three hundred years. Then one night we had nothing left to count.
The Sovereign is not a creature. It is the dark between your lanterns, given a will.
You two carry more light than you know. I can see it from here.
talia: Drink before you are thirsty. The desert does not give second chances.
The Sunwell kept the caravans alive for a thousand years. Now it only burns.
You two travel like people who have done this before.
oren: Every thorn here was a flower once. The Hollow teaches things to bite.
Walk where the moss is soft. The roots listen.
Your fox is welcome here. The jungle likes Lumen better than it likes me.
garrick: Mind the lava. It does not care how brave you are.
I forged lanterns for this whole country. Now I forge excuses.
Whatever the Hollow is making in my forge, it is not a horseshoe.
selene: Do not look down. Or do, the view is the best part.
The wind up here remembers every storm. Zephyrion is all of them at once.
Hold on to each other in the gusts. That is not a metaphor.
lioraflame: I have waited three hundred years for this night to end.
All the lanterns you lit are holding the door open for us.
The First Lantern chose well. It chose both of you.

npcTitles.ysolde: Last Ship of the Lantern Fleet
